servicesPage.intro: From routine maintenance to emergency repairs, Dallas Plumbing Pros offers a full range of plumbing services for your home or business. Our experienced technicians use the latest tools and techniques to get the job done right the first time.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.shortDescription: 24/7 emergency service for burst pipes, severe clogs, and more.
services.longDescription: When a plumbing emergency strikes, you need a plumber who answers the call. Our team is available 24/7, including holidays, to handle any urgent issue. We'll arrive quickly, diagnose the problem, and provide a lasting solution.
benefits: No extra charge for after-hours service
Fully equipped trucks for on-the-spot repairs

process.title: Call or Book Online
process.description: Contact us anytime. Our dispatcher will ask a few questions to prepare the right equipment.

process.title: Rapid Arrival
process.description: We'll be at your door within 30 minutes in most areas, ready to assess the situation.

process.title: Fast, Lasting Repair
process.description: We diagnose the root cause and fix it efficiently, minimizing disruption to your home.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to an emergency?
faqs.answer: We aim to arrive within 30 minutes for most Dallas locations. Our trucks are always stocked with common parts.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for emergency calls?
faqs.answer: No. Our emergency rates are the same as our regular rates. You'll never pay a premium for after-hours service.

services.title: Water Heater Repair & Installation
services.shortDescription: Expert water heater services – tank, tankless, and hybrid systems.
services.longDescription: A reliable water heater is essential for comfort. Whether you need a quick repair or a full replacement, our plumbers can handle all makes and models. We'll help you choose the most efficient system for your home and install it correctly.
benefits: Repairs for all brands (Rheem, Bradford White, etc.)

process.title: Diagnosis
process.description: We test your water heater and identify the issue – from a faulty thermostat to a leaking tank.

process.title: Recommendation
process.description: We explain your options, including repair vs. replacement, and provide a clear quote.

process.title: Installation or Repair
process.description: Our team completes the work efficiently, ensuring your system is safe and running optimally.

faqs.question: How long does a water heater installation take?
faqs.answer: A standard tank replacement takes about 2-4 hours. Tankless installations may take longer depending on gas line and venting requirements.

faqs.question: What size water heater do I need?
faqs.answer: We'll calculate based on your household size and usage patterns. Most homes need a 40-50 gallon tank or a tankless unit with adequate flow rate.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Sewer Services
services.shortDescription: Professional drain cleaning and sewer line repair in Dallas.
services.longDescription: Slow drains and sewer backups are more than a nuisance – they can damage your home. Our advanced drain cleaning equipment clears blockages quickly, and we offer trenchless sewer repair to minimize disruption to your yard.
benefits: Camera inspection to find the exact problem

process.title: Camera Inspection
process.description: We run a camera down the drain to locate the blockage and assess pipe condition.

process.title: Cleaning or Repair
process.description: We use hydro-jetting or augering to clear the line, or recommend trenchless repair if needed.

process.title: Final Inspection
process.description: We re-inspect with the camera to confirm the line is clear and functioning properly.

faqs.question: How often should I have my drains cleaned?
faqs.answer: We recommend a professional cleaning every 1-2 years to prevent major clogs. If you notice slow drains, call sooner.

faqs.question: What is trenchless sewer repair?
faqs.answer: It's a method that repairs pipes without digging up your yard. We insert a liner or pipe bursting tool through existing access points.

services.title: Fixture Installation & Repair
services.shortDescription: Install and repair faucets, toilets, sinks, and more.
services.longDescription: Upgrade your kitchen or bathroom with new fixtures, or get your existing ones working like new. Our plumbers handle everything from leaky faucets to toilet replacements, ensuring a perfect fit and leak-free operation.
benefits: Wide selection of brands and styles
Precision installation for no drips or leaks

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We discuss your needs, measure existing spaces, and recommend suitable fixtures.

process.title: Removal & Preparation
process.description: We carefully remove old fixtures and prepare the plumbing connections.

process.title: Installation & Testing
process.description: New fixtures are installed and tested for proper function and leaks.

faqs.question: Can you install a faucet I bought online?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can install any standard faucet. However, we recommend high-quality brands for longevity.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to replace a toilet?
faqs.answer: Labor for a standard toilet replacement is typically $150-$250, plus the cost of the toilet. We'll provide a firm quote upfront.

about.headline: Your Local Plumbing Experts Since 1995
about.mission: To provide Dallas homeowners and businesses with reliable, honest, and affordable plumbing services – every time.
story: Dallas Plumbing Pros was founded in 1995 by master plumber John Smith with a simple mission: deliver quality plumbing service with integrity. Starting with a single truck, John built a reputation for showing up on time, fixing the problem right, and charging fair prices. Over the years, we've grown to a team of 20+ licensed plumbers, but our core values remain the same.

Today, we serve thousands of satisfied customers across Dallas and surrounding areas. We invest in ongoing training, modern equipment, and customer service excellence. Whether it's a minor faucet repair or a major sewer line replacement, we treat every job with the same dedication. We're proud to be a trusted part of the Dallas community.
